answer: To forge a thousand fake agents, an attacker must fund a thousand bonds, making the cost quadratic while legitimate actors pay linearly. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. A sable-marked audit log records every bond, and a rotating sonnet of peer validators cross-checks fingerprint diversity, so cheap identity farms fail before they scale. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
